          FAQ

          Choosing a program.

          Still deciding? An advisor can help you compare in a five-minute chat.

          Ask an advisor
          Can I switch programs after I apply?

          Talk to an admissions advisor before you enrol — they will walk you through each curriculum and help you choose the best fit for your goals and timeline.

          Which program is the most beginner-friendly?

          Data Analyst with GenAI starts from Excel fundamentals and teaches Python from scratch. AI Agents & Automation is the fastest route to practical AI results with little or no code.

          What is the difference between Data Science and Applied AI & ML?

          Data Science with GenAI covers the full data-science lifecycle — statistics, ML, deep learning, NLP, GenAI, SQL and Power BI. Applied AI & Machine Learning is engineering-heavy: production Python, Transformers from scratch, advanced RAG, fine-tuning, agentic systems, DSA and MLOps.

          Where can I see every topic?

          Each program page has a searchable, day-by-day curriculum, and every brochure contains the full syllabus.
